findings: RTTI identifies the virtual-table type independently of message-format strings.
Both original message keys resolve through the same registry and compare both 32-bit words.
Registry comparison extracts the existing object key at object+0x18.
Deserializer fills two participant keys before conditional action payload groups.
Normal processing can queue primary and secondary actions rather than immediately call the formatter.
When actor lookup is absent, RVA 0x3ae454 can substitute victim key into the later event.
capture_requirement: Copy original decoded message keys and bounded scalar fields before native fallback or queued action transformations. Never infer attacker from selected object or fallback event.
